liebermann.description_de: British Museum, Cotton Vitellius A VII
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: London, British Library, Cotton MS Vitellius A.vii (Vt, the first pontifical)
liebermann.notes: Badly burnt. Vt (= Cv), the first pontifical, from Wessex c. 1060 (litany suggests shortly before 1000), most closely related to Rj and Ch, has the Sacramentum coronationis (f. 1, copied in Ju) and Iudicium Dei IX, I–III, VI, VII. Vt 2, a second pontifical of c. 1130, has Iudicium Dei XI–XIV, related to Mg and Tr.

entries.text_de:
British Museum, Cotton Vitellius A VII, stark angebrannt. F. 1 Sacr cor, o. S. 2141, copirt in Ju. Erstes Pontifical aus Wessex3 um 1060, nächstverwandt mit Rj, Ch, f. 4 Iud Dei IX, u. S. 416; f. 5—13 Iud Dei I—III, u. S. 401; f. 13 Iud Dei VI. VII 12—13 A, u. S. 412 ff.

Vt 2: Zweites Pontifical um 1130; f. 185b. 187b. 191. 196b Iud Dei XI. XII (hinter 7: I 5 und hinter 13: I 13—18). XIII. XIV, u. S. 419—427. Verwandt mit Mg Tr.
entries.text_en:
British Museum, Cotton Vitellius A VII, badly burnt. F. 1 Sacr cor, above, p. 2141, copied in Ju. First pontifical, from Wessex3, c. 1060, most closely related to Rj, Ch, f. 4 Iud Dei IX, below, p. 416; f. 5—13 Iud Dei I—III, below, p. 401; f. 13 Iud Dei VI. VII 12—13 A, below, p. 412 ff.

Vt 2: second pontifical, c. 1130; f. 185b. 187b. 191. 196b Iud Dei XI. XII (after 7: I 5 and after 13: I 13—18). XIII. XIV, below, pp. 419—427. Related to Mg Tr.

notes.text_de: Die Litanei f. 18 nennt Byrin, Swyðun, Aþelwold, Æglflæd, Edgyð: also kurz vor 1000. — Fol. 10 gehört vor 9.
notes.text_en: The litany f. 18 names Byrin, Swyðun, Aþelwold, Æglflæd, Edgyð: so shortly before 1000. — Fol. 10 belongs before 9.

transcription.doubts: 214<sup>1</sup> is a line reference (note 1 belongs to Vr). 'o. S. 214' printed 'o.' (above) as kept. 'Vt 2' printed with a space; siglum given as Vt2 in sigla list.
